thread:
Maria F.: Heads up — vendor invoice for March looks like it didn't apply the AB experiment grandfathering for cohort B. Line shows full list price charged for several accounts we expected to grandfather. Can someone on billing/revops triage before we lock payouts?

Tom L.: On it. Which vendor invoice id and a sample account? I'll run the reconciliation job now.

Maria F.: invoice id vendor_2026_03_31_42. Sample acct: acct_98765. Thanks.

Priya K.: Is this the cohort that had the experiment toggled off on Mar 15? If so, we might have a price_snapshot mismatch. I'll diff usage vs expected pricing.

Ashley R.: I rolled the price toggle back on the pricing-service on Mar 15 morning but the billing pipeline reads price_snapshot table (as_of date). If snapshots were generated before the rollback, that'd explain it.

Ben S.: I see a pattern — several affected accounts have usage_date between 2026-03-15 and 2026-03-20. Quick query I'm running:
```
SELECT u.account_id, u.usage_date, p.price_tier, p.experiment_tag
FROM usage u
JOIN price_snapshot p ON u.mcc = p.mcc
WHERE p.experiment_tag = 'AB-cohort-new'
  AND u.usage_date BETWEEN '2026-03-15' AND '2026-03-20';
```
This will show if snapshot applied the old price.

deploy-bot: pricing-service v2.4.1 rollback detected — rolled back at 2026-03-15T08:42Z (initiated by @Ashley R.).

Maria F.: That matches. Looks like billing ran with snapshot taken on 2026-03-14, before the rollback, so cohort B got old higher price. Can we issue credits to affected customers and coordinate with vendor invoice? Need quick approval threshold.

Ashley R.: Approve temporary customer credits for discrepancies under $5k total per invoice. Anything above that needs finance lead sign-off (CC CFO). I'll prepare a reversal note and a vendor communication template.

Priya K.: I'll generate the affected account list and drop a CSV in /shared/finance/pricing_ab_mismatch_2026-03-31.csv within 30m. Will include invoice line refs and suggested credit amounts.

Ben S.: Pinged vendor-ops; they said they can accept adjusted credits if we provide the corrected invoice and a one-time addendum. I'll coordinate signatures.

Maria F.: Great — @Ashley R. can you confirm we should go ahead with credits for invoices under the $5k cap? I'll hold sending vendor payout until Ben confirms.

Ashley R.: Confirmed. Proceed for under-$5k. For >$5k hold and escalate. Please annotate the reversal with experiment id and snapshot times.

Tom L.: I'll add a check to the nightly reconcile job to raise an alert when price_snapshot.as_of < experiment_change_time. Push a hotfix to staging today.

Maria F.: Thanks everyone. After CSV lands, I'll open a short Ops ticket to track credits and vendor sign-off. :thumbsup:

Ben S.: Noted — vendor requested signed addendum before they accept adjusted payout, so expect ~24-48h on their side. I'll update the ticket.

Maria F.: Perfect. Closing loop: once vendor confirms, finance will process the adjusted payout and RevOps will ensure customers get credits.

Ashley R.: I'll draft the vendor email and share in the thread when ready.

Tom L.: Follow-up: created issue FIN-4921 to add the alert and link to the CSV.

Maria F.: Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround.
